plain_text:
Ronald Colman appears in 66 recordings across 6 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1941 to 1953. The credits here include performer and writer.

In this archive, you will hear Ronald Colman most often in The Halls of Ivy, Lux Radio Theatre, Academy Award Theater, Encore Theater, Screen Directors Playhouse, and Screen Guild Theater.

Characters credited here include Dr. William Todhunter Hall.
